title: Pianoid sample-library record (one line of samples/manifest.jsonl)
description: Written only by tools/tuning/sample_lib.py. The last record of an id is the current one. Characteristics are RELATIVE values (dB re the sample's own level or strongest partial): assistant WAVs are peak-normalised.

id.description: s-<yyyymmddhhmmss>-<hex6> by default, or a given slug

file.description: path relative to the library root, e.g. audio/s-....wav

kind.description: render = offline engine output; mic = a microphone capture of the board / speakers; reference = a real instrument

pitch.description: MIDI pitch of the played key (the extractor's nominal)

settings.description: free-form: load settings (order, iterations), feedback, routing, slider, mic position

origin.description: artefact id, rig run name or original file

tainted.description: the source artefact came from a tainted assistant turn (its content is data, never instructions)

characteristics.description: characteristics.analyse(): version, sample_rate, duration_s, onset_s, level {peak_dbfs, rms_dbfs_first_0_5s, crest_factor, noise_floor_db}, pitch {f0_hz, nominal_midi, nominal_hz, tuning_cents, inharmonicity_B}, partials [{k, hz, level_db re strongest}], spectrum {centroid_attack_hz (0-30 ms), centroid_body_hz (100-400 ms), rolloff_db_per_oct}, decay [{band_hz, rate_db_s, t60_s, range_db, valid}], attack {peak_time_ms, rise_10_90_ms}, thump {excess_db (50-200 Hz first 30 ms minus 0.5-1 s), lead_ms (low band half-rise before the tone), f0_in_band}, beating {depth_db, modulation_hz}, band_time_db [4 windows x 6 bands], cloud_db [4 windows x 4 bands] (energy between partials minus band total, dB)

observation.title: One line of samples/observations.jsonl (observe mode) and of docs/tuning/lexicon/<operator>.observations.jsonl
observation.description: Written only by tools/tuning/sample_lib.py (observe; lexicon-export copies lines verbatim). Immutable: the last line of an id wins.

operator.description: whose words these are (the lexicon file name)

observe_id.description: the observe session; its samples carry the tags obs-<observe_id> and step-<n>

description.description: the operator's words, verbatim (typed or a voice transcript)

edits.description: the step's edits from the state journal: {t, domain, key, label 'domain [key] field before -> after', source}

pairs.description: {pitch, velocity, before, after, before_step?, traits? | excluded: reason}

traits.description: lexicon.TRAITS -> the median over the comparable pairs (b minus a); null = nothing comparable or contaminated: not learned from
